name: MP Materials Corp.
blurb: MP Materials operates Mountain Pass in California, the only producing rare-earth mining and processing facility in the United States. The company extracts and refines neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) oxide and in 2025 opened a full-scale permanent magnet manufacturing plant in Fort Worth, Texas. Its customers include General Motors under a long-term supply agreement for electric-vehicle traction motor magnets, and the U.S. government has backed the company with roughly $400 million in strategic investment.
recent: In early 2025 MP Materials inaugurated its Fort Worth magnet facility and began commercial NdFeB magnet shipments to GM, a landmark for domestic rare-earth supply-chain independence. The company's AI revenue exposure remains indirect — data-center cooling fans and robotics actuators use its magnets — but the robotics angle is drawing increasing investor attention as humanoid robot programs scale.
